The tileserver still says "Not valid input file: /data/germany.mbtiles". The tileserver-gl runs as user 1000:1000 and the volume is mounted read-only. My file is owned by root with 644, so 1000 should be able to read it. Let me check if the container can actually see the file, and check the exit code of the tileserver. The issue may be that the tileserver still crash-loops (exits) rather than the file being unreadable — "Not valid input file" then restarts. Actually the logs show it starts, prints "Not valid input file", "Starting server", "Listening" — then the loop repeats. So it starts listening but then something exits.
